- [Where do you shop for food in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/living/groceries-shopping-bali/): Local produce is cheap, imported goods are not, and the gap between the two is most of the difference in anyone's cost of living here.
- [What are gyms and fitness like in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/living/gyms-fitness-sport-bali/): An unusually strong fitness scene for a place this size, and it is a genuine reason people stay and a genuine amenity for a villa.
- [What is there for children to do in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/living/kids-activities-schools-sport-bali/): More than people expect, concentrated in a few areas, and it is what decides where families with children actually live.

## Bali vs The World

What foreigners can own, pay and keep in Bali against Dubai, Thailand, Portugal, Japan and the rest.

- [Which countries still sell residency for property?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/golden-visa-alternatives-2026/): Spain closed its golden visa. Portugal removed the property route. The list of countries still trading residency for capital is shorter every year.
- [Where in Asia can foreigners actually own property?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/foreign-property-ownership-asia/): Almost nowhere lets a foreigner own land. What separates these markets is what you get instead, and how long you keep it.
- [Which countries tax you for being rich?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/countries-with-no-wealth-tax/): Norway, Spain and Switzerland tax what you own. Indonesia taxes what you earn. Over a long hold that difference compounds into real money.
- [How does the Dutch Box 3 tax work?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/netherlands-box-3-tax/): The Dutch system taxes an assumed return on your assets rather than what they actually earned, which is why it has been fought through the courts.
- [Dubai or Bali for property?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/dubai-vs-bali-property/): Dubai gives you freehold and no income tax. Bali gives you 30 years and no freehold at all. The money keeps arriving in both.
- [Thailand or Bali for property?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/thailand-vs-bali-property/): Thailand gives you a condominium freehold and prosecutes the company workaround. Indonesia gives you no land at all and has criminalised the equivalent.
- [Why are so many Australians buying in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/australians-buying-in-bali/): Australians are the largest single group of foreign buyers here, and they keep making the same three mistakes.
- [Is Bali running out of land?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/bali-running-out-of-land/): Bali is building faster than almost anywhere in Asia and running out of the land worth building on at the same time. Both are true.
- [Can foreigners own property in Japan?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/japan-vs-bali-property/): Japan lets any foreigner own land outright with no restriction. Bali lets you own none of it. The money still goes to Bali, and the reason is instructive.
- [Can foreigners buy property in Vietnam?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/vietnam-property-foreigners/): Vietnam grants foreigners 50 years on an apartment. Indonesia grants 30 on a lease. Only one of them has a defined renewal path.
- [Is Malaysia MM2H better than Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/malaysia-mm2h-vs-bali/): Malaysia lets foreigners own freehold above state minimums and ties a long-stay visa to it. Bali offers neither. The trade-off is demand.
- [Can foreigners buy property in the Philippines?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/philippines-property-foreigners/): Foreigners can hold up to 40 percent of a condominium building and none of the land. Indonesia allows none of either, and still draws more capital.
- [Is Asia really cheaper on tax than Europe?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/europe-vs-asia-tax-expats/): Europe adds a levy most years. Asia opens a door. The part people get wrong is that the tax follows the person, not the property.
- [What does $130,000 buy in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/what-130k-buys-in-bali/): It is the number attached to Indonesia's Second Home route, and it buys very different things depending on where you point it.
- [Is it cheaper to build in Bali than Australia?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/build-villa-bali-vs-australia/): Over 1,500 Australian builders collapsed in a year and buyers lost deposits. Building here costs a fraction, and the risks are entirely different ones.
- [Can foreigners buy property in Jakarta?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/jakarta-property-foreigners/): The same national rules apply, but the market is apartments, tenants are corporate, and nobody is buying it for the lifestyle.
- [Is Sumba or Labuan Bajo the next Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/sumba-labuan-bajo-property/): Spectacular, genuinely early, and separated from Bali by a decade of infrastructure. The phrase next Bali does more harm than good here.
- [Singapore, Hong Kong or Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/singapore-hong-kong-vs-bali/): Both let foreigners own outright and both charge heavily for the privilege. Bali offers neither ownership nor the entry cost.
- [Is money moving from Dubai to Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/money-leaving-dubai-for-bali/): Dubai prices rose hard and yields compressed. Some of that capital went looking, and Bali caught part of it. Most of it is buying the wrong thing.
- [What does your money actually buy in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/what-money-buys-bali-vs-home/): The same figure buys a different life here, and the gap is widest on exactly the things most people cannot buy at home any more.
- [Bali or Lombok for investment?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/bali-vs-lombok-investment/): Lombok is a fraction of the price and a fraction of the demand. The question is whether you are buying income or buying time.
- [Canggu, Seminyak or Ubud?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/canggu-vs-seminyak-vs-ubud/): Three markets with different guests, different booking channels and different seasonality. The right one depends on what you are optimising for.
- [The Bukit or Canggu?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/bukit-vs-canggu/): Canggu has the steadiest occupancy in Bali. The Bukit has the biggest view premium and the water problem. They suit different buyers.
- [Portugal or Bali for property?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/portugal-vs-bali-property/): Portugal gives registered EU freehold and closed its golden visa property route. Bali gives higher yield and no ownership at all.
- [Sri Lanka or Bali for property?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/sri-lanka-vs-bali-property/): Sri Lanka is cheaper, earlier and far less liquid, with a foreign ownership restriction that works differently from Indonesia's.
- [Costa Rica or Bali for property?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/costa-rica-vs-bali-property/): Costa Rica lets foreigners own freehold outright, which Indonesia does not. Bali earns more and costs less to enter.
- [Mexico or Bali for property?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/mexico-vs-bali-property/): Mexico lets foreigners hold coastal property through a bank trust with beneficial ownership. Indonesia has no equivalent.
- [Nusa Penida or Lembongan?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/nusa-penida-vs-lembongan/): Penida is bigger, rawer and cheaper with a day-trip economy. Lembongan is smaller, more developed and has actual overnight demand.
- [Spain or Bali for property?](https://balioffscript.com/compare/spain-vs-bali-property/): Spain gives registered EU freehold and ended its golden visa. Bali gives higher yield and no ownership. The wealth tax is the wildcard.

## Bali Travel

When to come, what it costs, how to move around, and what nobody tells you before the first trip.

- [What is the weather in Bali each month?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-weather-month-by-month/): Temperature barely moves all year. What changes is rain, humidity, wind direction and sea clarity, and those four decide what your trip looks like.
- [Should you visit Bali in rainy season?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-rainy-season-truth/): It rains hard for an hour or two, usually in the afternoon, and then stops. Whether that ruins your trip depends entirely on how you plan the mornings.
- [Do tourists have to pay a fee to enter Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-tourist-levy/): Foreign visitors pay a one-off provincial levy of IDR 150,000 per person. Here is who it applies to, how to pay it before you land, and what happens if you do not.
- [What happens when you land at Bali airport?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-airport-arrival-guide/): Ngurah Rai is straightforward once you know the order: entry formalities, bags, customs declaration, then the taxi scrum. The scrum is the part that costs people money.
- [How long does it take to get from Bali airport?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-airport-transfer-times/): Google says 40 minutes to Canggu. In practice it is 60 to 90 in the afternoon. Here are the real numbers to the places people actually stay.
- [How do you get around Bali as a visitor?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/getting-around-bali/): Four options, each with a clear right answer depending on distance, confidence and what you are carrying. Most visitors default to the wrong one.
- [How do you rent a scooter in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/renting-a-scooter-bali/): Around 70,000 to 100,000 rupiah a day, no deposit culture, and one licence requirement that decides whether your insurance pays if anything happens.
- [How does hiring a driver in Bali work?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/private-driver-bali/): Around 600,000 to 900,000 rupiah for a full day including the car. What that buys, what is not included, and how to avoid the shopping-stop tour.
- [Can you use Grab and Gojek in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/grab-gojek-bali/): Both apps work across the south and are the cheapest way to move. The complication is that local transport cooperatives restrict pickups in specific places, and no app tells you where.
- [How much does a trip to Bali cost?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-trip-cost/): Daily budgets from roughly 35 dollars backpacking to 250 plus for the villa version, with the specific line items that surprise people.
- [How do you handle money in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-money-atms-cards/): Rupiah is cash-heavy outside the tourist strip, ATM fees are real, and the dynamic currency conversion trick at card terminals costs more than every other fee combined.
- [How do you get internet in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-sim-esim/): Coverage in the south is good and cheap. The choice is an eSIM bought before you fly, a local SIM registered with your passport, or relying on cafe wifi, which is the weakest of the three.
- [What scams should you watch for in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-scams-to-avoid/): Violent crime is rare. What exists is a set of predictable money routines around taxis, money changers, scooter damage, ATMs and fake tickets, all avoidable once you know the shape of them.
- [How do you avoid getting sick in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-belly-health/): Tap water is the main culprit, not street food. What to drink, what to be careful with, when a stomach upset becomes a clinic visit, and where those clinics are.
- [What are the rules for visiting temples in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-temple-etiquette/): A sarong and sash, covered shoulders, no entry during menstruation, never stand above a praying worshipper, and a short list of things that get visitors deported from the island's patience.
- [What happens on Nyepi in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/nyepi-bali/): For 24 hours nothing moves: no flights, no vehicles, no lights, nobody outside. Here is what it means, what you can and cannot do, and whether to plan a trip around it.
- [What ceremonies happen in Bali during the year?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-ceremonies-calendar/): Galungan, Kuningan, Nyepi, Saraswati and thousands of temple anniversaries. What each one means for a visitor, and why the calendar moves.
- [What should you pack for Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-packing-list/): Light clothes, a sarong, reef-safe sunscreen, proper repellent, a dry bag and shoes you can ride in. Plus the four things nobody packs and everybody buys here at a markup.
- [Is Bali good for a family holiday?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-with-kids-holiday/): Balinese culture is unusually welcoming to children, and the practical constraints are heat, traffic and sea safety. Sanur and Nusa Dua solve most of them; Canggu and Uluwatu do not.
- [Where should you go in Bali on honeymoon?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-honeymoon-guide/): Two bases beats one. Uluwatu or Ubud for the view and the quiet, then a beach for the last nights, and a hard rule about which infinity pool photographs are honest.
- [Is Bali good for solo travellers?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/solo-travel-bali/): Easy, social and well set up for it, with Canggu and Ubud doing most of the work. The practical questions are safety at night, transport and whether you want a scene or a place to think.
- [Can you fly a drone in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-drone-rules/): Registration requirements, no-fly zones around the airport, temples and ceremonies, and the practical etiquette that keeps you out of an argument with a village.
- [How dangerous is the sea in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-beach-safety/): The west coast has powerful rips and most beaches are unpatrolled. Knowing what a rip looks like, and what to do in one, is the single most useful thing on this site for a visitor.
- [What should you wear in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/what-to-wear-in-bali/): Beachwear at the beach, covered shoulders and knees in villages and temples, and something smarter than flip-flops for dinner. Plus what the humidity does to your clothes.
- [Do you tip in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-tipping-etiquette/): Not obligatory, widely appreciated, and in a few cases already on your bill. What is normal for drivers, guides, spas, villa staff and restaurants.
- [What Indonesian phrases should travellers know?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/indonesian-phrases-for-travellers/): Twenty words that change how you are treated, plus the handful of Balinese phrases that will genuinely surprise people. Bahasa Indonesia is one of the easiest languages to start.
- [How can you travel responsibly in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/responsible-travel-bali/): Water use, plastic, where your money goes and which animal attractions to avoid. The things that make a measurable difference, and the gestures that do not.
- [When is Bali busiest?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-peak-season-crowds/): July, August and the fortnight around Christmas are peak. Idul Fitri and Chinese New Year fill it domestically. Here is the crowd calendar and what it does to prices.
- [Is Bali accessible for people with mobility issues?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/accessible-travel-bali/): Footpaths are poor, most beaches involve steps and many villas have level changes. Sanur, Nusa Dua and the right hotel make a trip entirely workable.
- [What should Bali travel insurance cover?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-travel-insurance-what-matters/): Motorcycle cover, medical evacuation and diving depth limits are the three that decide whether a claim is paid here. Nearly everything else is standard.
- [What do you do in an emergency in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/travel/bali-emergency-help/): Ambulance, police and consulate numbers, which hospitals take foreigners, what to do after a scooter accident, and how lost passports actually get replaced.

## Where to Go

Every part of Bali worth your time, what it is actually like, and who each one suits.

- [Where should you stay in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/where-to-stay-in-bali/): Nine areas, what each one is actually like, who it suits and who it ruins. Picking wrong is the most common reason a first trip disappoints.
- [What is Canggu like to visit?](https://balioffscript.com/places/canggu-travel-guide/): The busiest part of Bali for under-40s, with excellent beginner surf and a cafe on every corner. Also the worst traffic on the island and a beach that is not for everybody.
- [What is Seminyak like to visit?](https://balioffscript.com/places/seminyak-travel-guide/): The most polished part of Bali, walkable by local standards, with the best dinner scene on the island and a long sunset beach. Older and calmer than Canggu, busier than Sanur.
- [What is Ubud like to visit?](https://balioffscript.com/places/ubud-travel-guide/): Rice terraces, river gorges, temples, yoga and the best food outside the south. Also traffic, crowds at the famous sights, and 90 minutes to the nearest beach.
- [What is Uluwatu like to visit?](https://balioffscript.com/places/uluwatu-travel-guide/): The most dramatic scenery in Bali, the best waves in Indonesia, and beaches at the bottom of long staircases. Wonderful for surfers and views, hard work for everyone else.
- [What is Sanur like to visit?](https://balioffscript.com/places/sanur-travel-guide/): The east coast, protected by a reef, with shallow calm water, a flat beachfront path and none of the surf-town noise. The best base in Bali for families and the easiest for everyone.
- [Should you stay in Jimbaran or Nusa Dua?](https://balioffscript.com/places/jimbaran-nusa-dua-guide/): Two sheltered-water areas near the airport with very different characters: seafood on the sand in a working fishing bay, or a manicured resort enclave with a toll road.
- [Is Kuta still worth visiting?](https://balioffscript.com/places/kuta-legian-guide/): Bali's original resort strip: cheap rooms, a long beginner surf beach with lifeguards, heavy nightlife, and a reputation that has moved on without it.
- [Is Sidemen worth visiting?](https://balioffscript.com/places/sidemen-east-bali-guide/): Rice terraces under Mount Agung, a river valley, almost no tourism and a handful of beautiful small hotels. What Ubud looked like before everyone found it.
- [Is Amed good for diving and snorkelling?](https://balioffscript.com/places/amed-diving-guide/): The best accessible underwater sites on the Bali mainland, including a wreck you can snorkel from the beach, in a string of quiet fishing villages on the east coast.
- [What is there to do in Munduk and Bedugul?](https://balioffscript.com/places/munduk-bedugul-guide/): Highland Bali at 1,200 metres: crater lakes, clove and coffee plantations, the best waterfall cluster on the island, and nights cold enough for a jumper.
- [What is the north coast of Bali like?](https://balioffscript.com/places/lovina-north-bali-guide/): Calm water, black sand, dolphin boats at dawn, hot springs and the best snorkelling in Bali at Menjangan. The least visited coast and the longest drive.
- [Which waterfalls in Bali are worth visiting?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-waterfalls/): There are dozens. About eight are worth the drive, and which ones depend on whether you want the photograph, the swim or the walk.
- [Where are the best rice terraces in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-rice-terraces/): One is 20 minutes from Ubud with swings and a queue. The other is a UNESCO site with walking trails and almost nobody. They are not the same experience.
- [Which temples in Bali are worth visiting?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-temples-to-visit/): Six that earn the drive, what each is actually like, when to go, and the dress rules that get people turned away at the gate.
- [Is the Mount Batur sunrise trek worth it?](https://balioffscript.com/places/mount-batur-sunrise-trek/): A 2am pickup, a two-hour climb in the dark and a sunrise over a caldera and lake. Straightforward for anyone reasonably fit, and busier than the photographs suggest.
- [Which are the best beaches in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-best-beaches/): White sand, black sand, calm water, big surf and empty sand are five different lists. Here is which beach belongs on which one.
- [Where should beginners surf in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-surfing-for-beginners/): Sand-bottom beach breaks with schools and lifeguards, not the famous reef waves. Kuta, Canggu and Sanur are where you learn; Uluwatu is where you watch.
- [Where is the best diving in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-diving-snorkelling/): A shore-accessible wreck at Tulamben, manta rays and mola mola at Nusa Penida, and the island's clearest reef at Menjangan. Four regions, each with its own season.
- [What should you eat in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-food-what-to-eat/): Babi guling, bebek betutu, nasi campur and sate lilit are the Balinese dishes worth going out of your way for, and almost none of them are at the beach clubs.
- [What is nightlife like in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-beach-clubs-nightlife/): Sunset beach clubs in Seminyak and Canggu, late bars in Kuta, cliff sunsets in Uluwatu and almost nothing in Sanur. Plus the drinks warning that actually matters.
- [Where do you do yoga and wellness in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-yoga-wellness/): Drop-in classes for a few dollars, teacher trainings, silent retreats and spa treatments at a fraction of home prices. Plus what to look for before paying for a week-long retreat.
- [Where do you shop in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-markets-shopping/): Ubud and Sukawati markets for crafts, Seminyak and Canggu for design, and a bargaining convention that confuses almost every first-time visitor.
- [What day trips can you do from south Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-day-trips-south/): Seven trips that work as a day, with honest driving times, and the three popular ones that do not work at all from the south.
- [What can you do in Bali in 5 days?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-itinerary-5-days/): One base, not three. Five days is enough for one region properly, and the mistake everyone makes is trying to see the whole island.
- [What is a good 7 day Bali itinerary?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-itinerary-7-days/): Three or four nights inland or on the cliffs, three or four on a beach, with one long day trip. The version that does not involve living in a car.
- [How should you plan 10 days in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-itinerary-10-days/): Ten days is the length at which you can add a third region or an island without spending the trip in transit.
- [What can you do in Bali in two weeks?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-itinerary-14-days/): Fourteen days covers the south, the centre, the east or north, and an island, with rest days built in. The version where you actually see Indonesia rather than a strip of the south.
- [What mistakes do first-time visitors make in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-first-time-mistakes/): Booking four areas in seven nights, underestimating drive times, learning to ride a scooter here, and six more that are entirely avoidable.
- [What can you do in Bali when it rains?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-rainy-day-activities/): Spas, cooking classes, museums, markets, coffee, and the specific indoor things that make a wet afternoon better than the beach day you lost.
- [Is west Bali worth visiting?](https://balioffscript.com/places/west-bali-tabanan-guide/): Black-sand beaches with nobody on them, the island's best rice terraces, a long left-hand surf break and a national park with dry forest and the last Bali starlings.
- [What is there to do in Bali with teenagers?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-with-teenagers/): Surf lessons, waterfalls, volcano treks, rafting and a social scene they can join. The areas that work and the ones that will bore them.
- [Where are the best photo spots in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-photography-spots/): The gates of heaven use a mirror, the swing costs extra and the queue is an hour. Here is what each famous shot actually involves, and where the better pictures are.
- [Are Bali cooking classes worth it?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-cooking-classes/): A market visit, a spice paste ground by hand, five or six dishes and lunch, for 300,000 to 600,000 rupiah. The best-value half day on the island.
- [Is Denpasar worth visiting?](https://balioffscript.com/places/denpasar-guide/): The island's capital, almost entirely ignored by visitors, with the best markets, a good museum, serious food and no tourism infrastructure at all.
- [What should you know about animals in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-animals-monkeys/): The monkeys will take your phone, the dogs are a rabies question, and a large part of the animal tourism on offer should be avoided outright.
- [What adventure activities are there in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-adventure-activities/): White-water rafting on two rivers, canyoning in the gorges, downhill cycling from the crater rim, and the safety questions worth asking before you book any of them.
- [What is Pererenan like to visit?](https://balioffscript.com/places/pererenan-cemagi-guide/): Ten minutes past Canggu, with a better beach, wider roads and most of the same cafes. Where the people who found Canggu too busy went.
- [How much is a massage in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-spa-massage-guide/): A good hour-long Balinese massage costs 100,000 to 250,000 rupiah at a local spa and five times that in a resort. What the traditional treatments actually are.
- [Where can you find quiet in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/bali-quiet-places/): The tourist crowd occupies about 20 kilometres of coast and one town inland. Everywhere else is quiet, and here is where to go.
- [What are the best things to do in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/places/things-to-do-in-bali/): Twenty things worth your time, ranked by whether they justify the drive, plus the famous ones that do not.

## Islands & Indonesia

Nusa, the Gilis, Lombok, Komodo, Java and the rest of the country, and how to reach them.

- [What is Nusa Penida like to visit?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/nusa-penida-guide/): The most dramatic coastline in the region, an island of bad roads and cliff staircases, and a day trip that half the people who do it regret rushing.
- [Is a Nusa Penida day trip worth it?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/nusa-penida-day-trip/): A 6am start, a 40-minute boat, four sights on rough roads and a boat back at 4pm. Spectacular and rushed. Here is how to do it well, or why to stay two nights instead.
- [What is Nusa Lembongan like?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/nusa-lembongan-guide/): Eight square kilometres, no traffic to speak of, good snorkelling, mangroves and a bridge to Ceningan. The most relaxed island trip you can make from Bali.
- [Is Nusa Ceningan worth visiting?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/nusa-ceningan-guide/): A narrow island joined to Lembongan by a yellow bridge, with a blue lagoon, cliff jumping, seaweed farms and about two hours of sights. Worth an afternoon, not a trip.
- [How do you get to Nusa Penida from Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/bali-to-nusa-penida-boat/): Fast boats from Sanur take 30 to 45 minutes and run all day. Which port, what it costs, how rough it gets and what to do about cancellations.
- [Which Gili island should you visit?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/gili-islands-which-one/): Three car-free islands off Lombok with the same turquoise water and completely different characters: party, balance, and almost nothing at all.
- [What is Gili Trawangan like?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/gili-trawangan-guide/): The biggest and busiest Gili, with the best dive infrastructure, a lively east strip and a completely quiet west coast fifteen minutes away.
- [Should you stay on Gili Air or Gili Meno?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/gili-air-meno-guide/): Air has the best balance of quiet and dinner options. Meno is nearly empty with turtles off the beach. Neither has traffic, nightlife or reliable ATMs.
- [What is Lombok like to visit?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/lombok-travel-guide/): Bali's neighbour with a fraction of the visitors: white-sand bays in the south, a 3,726-metre volcano in the north, and the Gilis off the west coast.
- [What is Kuta Lombok like?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/kuta-lombok-guide/): A small town on the south coast with a dozen white-sand bays within half an hour, the best beginner surf in Indonesia, and a MotoGP circuit that has changed the area fast.
- [What is the Mount Rinjani trek like?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/mount-rinjani-trek/): Two to four days, a crater lake, hot springs and a 3,726-metre summit climb on loose scree. The best trek in Indonesia that ordinary travellers do, and much harder than Batur.
- [How do you get from Bali to Lombok?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/bali-to-lombok-transport/): A 30-minute flight, a 2 to 4-hour fast boat, or a cheap 5-hour public ferry. Which to choose depends on where you are going and how much the sea bothers you.
- [Is Komodo worth visiting from Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/komodo-labuan-bajo-guide/): Dragons, pink sand, Padar's viewpoint and some of the best diving in Indonesia, an hour and a half by plane from Bali. Expensive, permit-heavy and worth it.
- [Should you do a Komodo liveaboard?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/komodo-liveaboard-trips/): Two to four nights on a boat reaches the sites the day trips cannot, and puts you at Padar at sunrise. What they cost, what to check, and the safety questions that matter.
- [What is there to see in Flores?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/flores-kelimutu-guide/): Three coloured crater lakes, traditional villages, hot springs and one of the great drives in Indonesia, on an island most visitors only use as the airport for Komodo.
- [Is Sumba worth visiting?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/sumba-travel-guide/): Rolling savannah, waterfalls, some of the emptiest beaches in Indonesia, megalithic tombs and a surviving ancestral religion. Expensive at the top end and very cheap below it.
- [Is Raja Ampat worth the trip?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/raja-ampat-guide/): The most biodiverse reefs on earth, at the far end of Indonesia and the far end of most budgets. What it takes to get there and what you actually see.
- [Is Yogyakarta worth visiting from Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/yogyakarta-borobudur-guide/): A 90-minute flight to the cultural capital of Java, the largest Buddhist monument in the world and a Hindu temple complex to match. The best three days in Indonesia outside the water.
- [How do you visit Bromo and Ijen from Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/bromo-ijen-east-java/): A caldera at sunrise and a sulphur mine with blue flames burning in the dark, both reachable from Bali in a three or four-day loop by ferry.
- [Can you travel overland from Bali to Java?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/java-overland-from-bali/): Ferry from Gilimanuk to Ketapang, then Ijen, Bromo, Yogyakarta and onward by train. One of the best overland routes in Asia, and entirely doable by public transport.
- [Is Lake Toba worth visiting?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/lake-toba-sumatra/): The largest volcanic lake in the world, with an island in it the size of Singapore, Batak culture, and cool air. Three days from Bali and worth it if you have the time.
- [What is there to see in Sulawesi?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/sulawesi-bunaken-toraja/): Wall diving at Bunaken, empty islands in the Togeans, and the funeral culture of Tana Toraja. The most interesting island in Indonesia for travellers who have done the others.
- [Where are Indonesia's best surf trips?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/indonesia-surf-trips-mentawai/): Beyond Bali: boat trips in the Mentawais, the points of Sumbawa, Java's G-Land, and what each costs and demands.
- [How do you island hop in Indonesia?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/indonesia-island-hopping/): Seventeen thousand islands, a handful of sensible routes, and the flights, ferries and fast boats that connect them without wasting a week in transit.
- [Which island should you visit from Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/which-island-from-bali/): Nusa Penida for scenery, Lembongan for ease, the Gilis for turquoise water, Lombok for space, Komodo for diving. Distances, costs and who each one suits.
- [Should you go to Bali or Lombok?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/bali-vs-lombok-holiday/): Bali has the infrastructure, the food and the culture. Lombok has the beaches, the space and lower prices. The right answer depends on whether you want things done for you.
- [Where is the best snorkelling in Bali?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/menjangan-pemuteran-guide/): A protected island inside a national park with 30-metre visibility and a wall that drops into blue, plus a village with a coral restoration project on its house reef.
- [Is Komodo or Raja Ampat better for diving?](https://balioffscript.com/islands/komodo-vs-raja-ampat/): Komodo is closer, cheaper and has stronger currents. Raja Ampat has the highest marine biodiversity on earth and costs twice as much to reach. Which one suits which diver.
